title: taskflow close planning mirror closeback orchestration
description: Make taskflow close the single operator-facing closeback orchestration story so planning-mirror closeback, historical-delivery close, and residue repair are explained through one governed flow instead of split contract and writer cards.
acceptance: taskflow close exists as the official operator-facing closeback orchestration surface.
The close plan can distinguish normal close, historical-delivery close, planning-mirror repair, and ambiguous/manual-review residue.
tasks close, tasks reconcile, and residue diagnostics remain the authoritative backends.
The planning-mirror writer story stays adopter-aware and does not become a second writer.
This follow-up remains a single card and is not split into separate contract/writer cards.
notes: 2026-06-11 | status: done | validation: passed | change: taskflow close closeback orchestration with planning-mirror writer boundary | blocker: none

title: Framework auto-stage must honor claim globs and include dirty release mirrors
description: Fix framework auto-stage so claim globs such as release/** include dirty release mirrors and fail closed when claim-scoped dirty files remain.
acceptance: Claim globs match concrete dirty paths during framework auto-stage.
Dirty tracked release mirrors are committed with --auto-stage, not only git-head.jsonl.
Focused regression covers claim release/** with dirty release mirrors.
Backlog ATM-BUG-2026-07-11-108 marked Fixed in TASK-AAO-0157.

title: Governance validator parallelism, progress, and cancellation
description: Parallelize independent governance-validator fixture groups, surface phase progress, and provide cancellation with durable failure evidence while preserving the full deterministic lane.
acceptance: Independent fixture groups run through a bounded parallel scheduler while shared-state groups remain serialized.
Progress, cancellation, and failure summaries identify phase ids and elapsed time.
The warm default lane completes under 30 seconds or retains measured dominant-phase evidence.
Backlog ATM-BUG-2026-07-12-122 is updated only after command-backed acceptance evidence passes.

title: Scope-aware encoding guard and temporary artifact isolation
description: Make encoding checks task-scope-aware and classify foreign temporary artifacts without deleting or modifying another actor's files.
acceptance: Claimed or staged task files are checked without foreign temporary artifacts becoming task failures.
Explicit and whole-worktree modes retain fail-closed malformed-file detection.
Candidate output distinguishes checked, quarantined temporary, and unsupported files.
Canonical backlog/map closeback is added only through a later ATM scope amendment after shared ownership releases.

title: Governed commit audit deferral and lease renewal
description: Align commit bundle, protected-audit deferral, hook scope checks, and claim lease renewal for long governed commits.
acceptance: Foreign protected audit is deferred without scope drift.
Task-owned audit is consistently admitted.
Long evidence or commit paths retain a valid claim lease or provide retry-safe renewal.
